title: Freeze by Sxnail
description: A Plugin for Server Owners and moderators to freeze Players. Frozen players can´t break bocks, move or die etc.
body:
A  Plugin for Paper Servers to help moderators and owners :

**_Features:_**

Adds these Commands:

/freeze player | all      #This command freezes the Player or all Players that are online 

/unfreeze player | all    #This command unfreezes the Player or all Players taht are online 

/freezebypass player      #This command makes Players immune to being frozen

/freezealways on | off    #This command freezes Players even if they login after this command was used

/freezecheck player       #This command is used to check if a Player is curently frozen 

**_How to report Issues and Bugs:_**

Just join my Discord and open a ticket.
